description: This file defines the PagerSelectExtender class, which extends query functionality for paginated database queries in Drupal. It manages pagination parameters, count queries, and execution logic for paged results.

classes.name: PagerSelectExtender
classes.description: Extends database select queries to add pagination support, including managing page limits, elements, and count queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PagerSelectExtender with a select query and database connection, adding a pager tag.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Prepares and runs the paginated query, calculating total items and applying range based on current page.

methods.name: ensureElement
methods.description: Ensures that the pager element ID is set, assigning a new one if necessary.

methods.name: setCountQuery
methods.description: Sets a custom count query for pagination.

methods.name: getCountQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the count query, either custom or generated from the main query.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of items per page.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Sets the element ID for the pager, used to differentiate multiple pagers on the same page.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the element ID used for this pager.
